evals.name: berlin-access-delete
evals.prompt: Got this email on Tuesday October 13 from a user in Berlin who has an account with us: 'Under Article 15 GDPR I want a copy of all the data you have on me, and then I want my account deleted. — Lena M.' She also mentioned she used to live in California. What do we do?
evals.expected_output: Two request types (access, then deletion), sequenced so access is fulfilled before deletion. GDPR applies (Provisional; territorial scope basis noted); CCPA only if currently a California resident, so asks and treats as Provisional. Runs deadlines.py from 2026-10-13: GDPR one month to 2026-11-13; CCPA ack 10 business days 2026-10-27 and 45 days 2026-11-27 if it applies; earliest substantive deadline at top. Verification via account login or email on file, no ID document by default. Data location from RoPA, with search owners and processors. Drafts acknowledgment (DRAFT: not sent). Notes Art. 15(1)(a)-(h) content and Art. 17(3) exceptions for deletion as Provisional with a Decision needed for any retention. Case file under dsr/2026/. No calendar. Reply about 150 words.

evals.name: parent-reading-app
evals.prompt: A parent emailed: 'I want to see everything your reading app has collected about my son Theo (age 9, Maple Elementary) and I want it deleted.' We provide the app to the school district under a contract where we're a school official. What should we do?
evals.expected_output: Company is a FERPA school official (Provisional), so the request is forwarded to the district/institution with an offer of help; the company does not answer the substance or delete on its own. Notes FERPA 45-day inspect and review (34 CFR 99.10) and that deletion under FERPA isn't a right (amendment is), while COPPA parental review and deletion (16 CFR 312.6) applies where data was collected on school authorization, so the district coordinates. Verify parent relationship proportionately via the district. Runs deadlines.py for ferpa. Drafts the forwarding note to the district and a short holding reply to the parent, both DRAFT: not sent. State student privacy law flagged per district state. Case file status Forwarded. Reply about 150 words.
